title: Associate Creative Director
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

O WPP Media   

WPP Media to globalna organizacja mediowa należąca do grupy WPP, skupiająca marki Choreograph, EssenceMediacom, Mindshare i Wavemaker.

W świecie, w którym media są wszędzie i we wszystkim, łączymy najlepsze platformy, ludzi i partnerów, aby tworzyć nieograniczone możliwości wzrostu.  

Dołączając do nas korzystasz z programów przygotowujących do zawodów przyszłości oraz pracujesz ze specjalistami, których kompetencje potwierdzone są certyfikatem DIMAQ . W WPP Media nie tylko używamy technologii - my ją tworzymy. Dzięki naszym autorskim narzędziom, takim jak platforma WPP Open (platforma AI dla marketingu), będziesz pracować na międzynarodowych projektach i wspierać klientów na całym świecie. W WPP Media możesz korzystać z globalnych zasobów i kontaktów całej sieci WPP, poszerzać sieć znajomości i uczyć się od najlepszych w marketingu i reklamie. 

Jako Top Employer Poland & Europe 2021-2025 tworzymy środowisko pracy oparte na zaufaniu i wysokich standardach HR. Po raz drugi z rzędu (2024 i 2025) Magazyn Media & Marketing uhonorował nas tytułem Grupy Mediowej Roku.

Więcej informacji możesz znaleźć na stronie wppmedia.com    

 

Gdzie będziesz rozwijać swoje kompetencje?

W  T&P  łączymy kreatywność, technologię i media, by dostarczać naszym Klientom kompleksowe rozwiązania komunikacyjne. Nasza przedsiębiorcza struktura działa w 45 biurach na czterech kontynentach.  

Jako część jednej z największych grup mediowych, gwarantujemy najlepszy potencjał negocjacyjny dla naszych Klientów, a Tobie możliwość wzbogacenia i wzmocnienia swojej kariery, o doświadczenie w miejscu, które ciągle się rozwija.  

Jak będzie wyglądała Twoja praca?

Jako ASSOCIATE CREATIV DIRECTOR dołączysz do zespołu, w którym będziesz odpowiadać za wyznaczanie kierunku kreatywnego projektów, rozwijanie zespołu oraz budowanie partnerskich relacji z klientami. Połączysz strategiczne myślenie i kreatywność z biznesowym podejściem, przekładając potrzeby klientów na angażujące koncepcje i skuteczne rozwiązania komunikacyjne. Będziesz mieć wpływ na rozwój oferty kreatywnej, jakość realizowanych projektów i poszukiwanie nowych możliwości współpracy.

Na co dzień będziesz m.in.:

• wyznaczać kierunek kreatywny projektów i kampanii, dbając o ich jakość, spójność i zgodność ze strategią marek,

• prowadzić i rozwijać zespół kreatywny, wspierać jego członków w codziennej pracy, dzielić się wiedzą i rozwijać ich kompetencje,

• budować partnerskie relacje z klientami, rozumieć ich potrzeby biznesowe i proponować rozwiązania odpowiadające na ich wyzwania,

• prezentować i sprzedawać koncepcje kreatywne, przekonująco argumentując rekomendowane rozwiązania,

• proaktywnie identyfikować nowe możliwości biznesowe i inicjować działania rozwijające współpracę z klientami,

• tworzyć i rozwijać koncepcje kreatywne oraz nadzorować ich realizację w różnych kanałach komunikacji - od digitalu i social mediów po ATL, telewizję i outdoor,

• koordynować pracę zespołu, ustalać priorytety i dbać o terminową realizację projektów,

• współpracować z zespołami strategii, mediów, client service i produkcji, łącząc różne kompetencje w spójne rozwiązania komunikacyjne,

• śledzić trendy i poszukiwać nowych formatów, technologii oraz możliwości rozwoju

title: Power Systems Studies Engineer - Dynamic Modeling
description:
The Opportunity
Ulteig is currently seeking talented and motivated Studies level engineering candidates to support power system studies and transmission planning projects within the renewable energy and power markets
What You'll Do
The Studies Engineer for the dynamic studies team is expected to perform the following tasks:

• Develop PSSE, PSLF, TSAT, and PSCAD models of renewable plants

• Perform model quality tests and model benchmarking for various software models

• Understand dynamic model block diagrams and tune parameters to meet regional model performance requirements

• Design and model custom master plant controls for large multi-resource renewable projects (PV, BESS, Datacenters)

• Research and test relatively new available models of datacenter loads and understand the challenges posed to the grid

• Work closely with the business development team to understand customer needs and application

• Work with SCADA engineers in charge of building and implementing master plant controls

• Support proposal efforts by demonstrating theoretical renewable generation and datacenter co-located plant operation

• Model master plant control in parallel with the design of master plant control to understand and mitigate any challenges

• Respond quickly to customer design changes, questions, and deadlines, and maintain a flexible attitude toward the work

• Stay current with regulatory changes, new grid codes, and evolving ISO/RTO requirements related to grid interconnections

• Conduct various dynamic simulations including voltage and frequency ride through, voltage step change, frequency step change, SCR tests, and fault analyses

• Support model validation and model benchmarking

• Stay up to date on new industry guidance and standards for modeling and requirements for inverter-based resources and datacenters

• Help develop tools to automate and streamline model quality tests and analyses

What We Expect from You

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering required, ABET accredited program, or equivalent required

• A minimum of 5 years of working experience directly related to power systems or control systems

• Experience with Matlab Simulink

• Experience with dynamic analysis utilizing PSS®E and PSCAD software, preferred

• Experience in conducting analysis on multi-resource renewable projects, preferred

• Experience developing custom user-defined models in PSS®E or PSCAD software, preferred

• Experience with programming in Python, preferred

• Actively manages individual workload, adapts to changing requirements, maintains flexibility

• Must be a self-starter and willing to identify improvements and implement them, utilizing support from others

• Must be comfortable asking questions to team when learning new skills · Must be analytical, self-motivated, and possess the ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a positive, enthusiastic attitude

• Excellent presentation and verbal/written communications skills

• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, management, clients and external agencies

• Innovative mindset

• Permanent authorization to work in the U.S

As you consider applying for a position at Ulteig , we encourage you to think outside the box - because we do! You might not meet 100% of the skills listed in a description, but we are committed to hiring people with exceptional talent, ability and potential, and then creating an environment where they can become the best versions of themselves. We don’t want to miss out on the possibility of speaking with the next outstanding Ulteig team member, so please apply if you think this role is a great match for your unique skills and strengths. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

MARKETPLACE HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

- Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

- Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

- Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

- A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Product Analyst, Marketplace at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

- Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

- Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

- Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

- Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking

title: Principal Hardware Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Aurelius is the autonomous directed energy company.

We are a group of engineers, operators, and company patriots building American-made, laser-based, counter-UAS defense systems that neutralize aerial threats.

We're a small team that designs in San Francisco, manufactures in Detroit, and field tests Archimedes, our fiber-laser counter-UAS system, weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You'll own hardware architecture across Archimedes and take subsystems from working prototype to hardware that ships and survives in the field.

This is a senior IC seat, not a people-manager job. You've done the full cycle more than once, you know where systems break and where teams get stuck, and you still like doing the hardest part yourself. Weekly range time and a Detroit manufacturing hub mean your decisions show up in metal, not just in a review deck.

As a Principal Hardware Engineer you will set the system-level hardware architecture, close the hardest design and manufacturing trades, and stand up the release path with Detroit. You'll work daily with electrical, power, embedded, optics, and manufacturing, and stay close enough to the bench and the floor to catch what the model misses.

MUST-HAVES

- Track record taking complex hardware the full cycle from prototype through manufacturing and field deployment, more than once

- Deep mechanical expertise plus real judgment in at least one of electrical, power electronics, or embedded

- Comfort being the technical anchor on a small team, still hands-on, not the manager of a large org

- Evidence of systems that had to survive real-world shock, vibration, and environmental conditions

- U.S. citizenship (required for export control).

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Priority deliverables in the first 6 months:

- A system-level hardware architecture and integration plan across mechanical, electrical, power, embedded, and optics

- The hardest open design trades closed, with documented decisions on cost, mass, reliability, and field performance

- A hardware release and production process standing up with the Detroit manufacturing hub

- Design review and documentation standards the rest of the hardware team can run against

- Hands-on debug and characterization of the current system so field failures get fixed at the root, not patched

NICE TO HAVES

It would help if…

- Directed energy, laser, or high-power systems experience

- Defense or aerospace program experience with MIL-STD or equivalent environmental qualification

- You've stood up a production line, or worked tightly with the manufacturers who did

- Active security clearance or ability to obtain one.

NOT A FIT IF

- You're a people manager without recent hands-on hardware work

- Your experience is simulation only, limited to one narrow subcomponent, or purely consumer products

- You need remote or hybrid work

HOW WE WORK

At Aurelius we work what we call, 5+X. Our core operating hours are 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Pacific Time.

The X is the honest acknowledgment that hard work sometimes takes more. For engineering, that means late nights and weekends during sprints and ramp-up periods.

For growth, ops, and support, it means conferences, deployments, and events when the mission calls for it.

This role is onsite 5 days a week in San Francisco.

BENEFITS

At Aurelius Systems, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package is available at little to no cost to employees and supports health, recovery, and whatever comes next. Explore Our Benefits https://www.aureliussystems.com/careers#:~:text=Explore%20Our%20Benefits.

EXPORT CONTROL NOTICE

This role requires access to export-controlled information or items and requires U.S. citizenship.

APPLY

Email our Head of Talent, alfredo@aureliussystems.us with your resume, GitHub, or a link to the most extraordinary thing you've built or done.
